profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at TransAstra
profile.summary: I am a Lead Software Engineer at TransAstra. I graduated from Worcester Polytechnic Institute with a bachelor's degree in Computer Science with a minor in Business. I'm passionate about space launch, travel, and exploration. I hope to further humanity's access to space and to enable further exploration of the vast secrets space has to share. During my free time, I like to cook and bake, and enjoy taking in nature on walks.

projects.title: Universal Nanoindentation Toolkit (UNiT)
projects.description: Developing a robust toolkit for the analysis of traditional nanoindentation data. Enabling Materials Scientists to use algorithms proposed in the literature to compute metrics that typically require other machines and more materials to compute.

projects.title: Investigating the Suitability of Tableau Dashboards and Decision Trees for Particulate Materials Science and Engineering Data Analysis
projects.description: Conducted a user study to investigate the suitability of Tableau Dashboards to enable Materials and Data Scientists to review and explore hundreds of thousands of particles’ size, shape, and morphological properties. The project was accepted to present a poster and proceedings to the 2022 TMS conference titled: “AI/Data Informatics: Computational Model Development, Validation, and Uncertainty Quantification”.
